hypothesis: PIPELINE CALIBRATION, not a strategy test (D-013). Re-implement Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 12-month time-series momentum on the inherited 54-futures daily file through qe.gateway + qe.engine; the inherited result (H0007, Sharpe 1.17 on 1984-2016, references/trend-following-run.txt) must be reproduced. A match proves the daily pipeline, never re-opens H0007.
rules: Monthly at the last trading day of each month t: for each asset with >= 252 days of history, signal = sign(12-month total return to day t); position from the next day's close, held one month; size = 40% / (ex-ante annualised EWMA vol, centre of mass 60 days, computed with data through day t); portfolio = equal-weight average across assets available that month; no costs in the calibration headline (the inherited run had none), 1x/2x cost runs attached for information (1 bp per side on gross notional per rebalance).
parameters: lookback 12m; EWMA com 60d; per-asset vol target 40%; monthly rebalance
instruments: the 54 futures in daily_futures_1984_2016 (VF removed, EO reset 1999-01-04 per inherited cleaning)
vol_scaler: ex-ante EWMA com 60d per asset, through day t, no cap/floor (as MOP)
cost_model: headline gross (calibration); 1x = 1 bp per side on traded notional, 2x run attached, information only
decision_rule: Pipeline passes if OOS (1990-2016) gross annualised Sharpe lies in [0.85, 1.45] AND the sign of each calendar year's return matches the inherited run in >= 80% of years. Outside: testing halts until the Data QA Auditor and the Re-implementer name the cause in writing. No edge claim either way.
notes: post-change: n/a. Counts one (calibration replication, non-negotiable 4). Inherited expected value 1.17 (p5 0.82) is on 1984-2016 incl. IS; OOS-only expected about 1.1.
